label: Program quality
description: Describe a well-designed program with clear activities, target population, and expected outcomes.

scoring.desc: Program design is unclear or outcomes are not stated.
Program design is clear but outcomes are output-level rather than outcome-level.
Program design is evidence-informed, activities map to outcomes, and outcomes are measurable.

common_failures: Activities that do not connect to stated outcomes
No evidence base or logic model

label: Organizational capacity
description: Show the organization has staff, governance, and fiscal systems to execute the program.

scoring.desc: Capacity is described but key roles are unfilled or track record is limited.
Capacity is documented with named staff, prior performance, and fiscal controls.

label: Community need
description: Document the community need with Alaska-specific data and community voice.

scoring.desc: Need is asserted without data or community input.
Need is cited from one source but community voice is not present.
Need is triangulated across data sources and community input.

common_failures: No community listening sessions or surveys

label: Budget
description: Present a line-item budget that is reasonable, allowable, and tied to the scope of work.

scoring.desc: Budget is a lump sum or contains unallowable costs.
Budget has line items but justifications are thin.
Budget ties every line to activities with justified unit costs and a clear match story if required.

common_failures: Unallowable costs such as lobbying or entertainment
